_doc: Provenance pins (form-source-inventory.js): each row is a generator that hashes an EXTRACTED tree at a fixed sha, honoured only while the WHOLE generator and the consumer test's `// PROVENANCE-PIN:BEGIN <consumer_region>` … `END` region are byte-identical to the reviewed versions (sha256 below). To re-register after a reviewed change: set site_sha256 = `shasum -a 256 <generator>` and consumer_sha256 = the sha256 of the exact bytes between the two marker lines, as its own reviewed diff.
